overview.title: A different register of the city
overview.p1: Tetouan’s Modern Art Museum offers a break from souks and white lanes: contemporary Moroccan work, temporary shows and space to look without the noise of the medina.
overview.p2: It suits travellers who want culture beyond monuments. Pair it with the Archaeological Museum for a full museum morning, or use it as a quiet afternoon when the alleys feel hot.
overview.p3: Check current exhibitions — the programme changes and is part of the reason to go.

q1.question: Ticket required?
q1.answer: Yes — museum entry fee. Cash backup recommended.

q2.question: How long?
q2.answer: Forty-five to ninety minutes depending on exhibitions.

q3.question: Suitable for children?
q3.answer: Older children who can stay quiet in galleries; not a playground stop.

q4.question: Near the medina?
q4.answer: Reachable by short taxi or a longer walk depending on your starting point.

q5.question: Photography?
q5.answer: Follow room rules; some shows restrict photos.

food.title: Eat near the museum
food.p1: Plan coffee before or a meal after in the new town or back at the square.
food.p2: Museum days work well with a Spanish-quarter lunch.
food.li5: Combine with archaeology if both are open
